title: O My Lord "I Tried to Know Your Orders"
body:
(Deutsch WasHastDuGelernt)
As-salamu ` alaykum yaa `ibaadAllah, the servants of our Lord, Allah Almighty. (Mawlana stands) O our
Lord! Forgive us, help us, bless us. Alfu, alfu salaat, alfu, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa’l-aakhireen.
Madad yaa RijaalAllah. We are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani
'r-Raheem.
If you are asking for a connection with heavenly levels, you must say a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'rrajeem and Shaytan is just kicked out. And we are saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, and angels
saying, "Welcome to you, welcome to you, our Lord's servant."
We know nothing. We are only depending on what our Grandshaykh is putting through my heart and
speaking. I am not claiming that I am knowing something. Everyone is knowing more than me and according
to your knowledge you are going to be judged. "O My servant! Come and say, what you learned through your
whole life?" "I learned this and that, this and that." And as you learned, you lived. You were making just
straight on that way? You learned but were not keeping what you learned. What you must learn? Madad yaa
Sultan al-awliya, madad yaa rijaalAllah. What you are going to learn, when He, Almighty asking? We must

know what we learned and for what we learned it.
What was the real aim from learning? "I learned to be driver. I learned to know how to fly planes."
What you learned? "I learned to be a computer engineer."
What you learned? "I learned to build concrete buildings."
What you learned? "I learned how you may make a car."
Angels may ask, which brand! (Laughter) Going outside because I must swear, okay? Anyone, if not happy
may go. More than here, over there swearing on him.
Oh what you learned? "I learned baking."
You, what you learned? "I was such a person never learning, but I am putting on my chest and behind me,
'political person,' you know? Because I was first-class person and I just fought against monarchies and
coming on their thrones to make my ego happy and to be so proud."
You? "I learned to make gramophone." "I learned to drive horses."
You, Abdur-Razzaq, what you learned? He is saying, "I learned to carry donkeys." So many things. Very
happy, Abdur-Razzaq. I am sending him...
What you learned? "I learned to make sausages because Chechnyan people they love it too much and I was
preparing for dogs bones because they like it also."
You, what you were learning? "I learned important things that I can't say about in your Divinely Presence,
you know?"
You? "I learned to be shepherd."
So many kinds of learning. If the Lord of Heavens asking, I don't know how many people may say, "I tried to
know Your orders; I was learning how I can keep my ego from evils; I learned how people can save
themselves from devils. You may ask, "What is it, devils?" Devils are cheating ones, O people. Cheating

people. Cheaters.
Perhaps through billions, you may take a handful of people who were trying to learn about their Lord. Leave
about their Lord, but they were asking to know what are the rights of their Creator. Now people are foolish
ones. If you are asking, "How you are in existence?" He is saying, "My dad through my mom creating me."
Your "creator" your mom and dad? Haasha! Ptuh! No one saying that, "My Lord created me." And what was
your mission when you are knowing Who created you? Then you learned what was your mission?
This is for whole Mankind now that they be listening through east and west, ••••• ••••••••••••• •••••••••• ••••
•••••••••• - "thumma latus'alunna yawmaidhin `ani 'n-na`eem - then, shall you be questioned that Day, about
the joy (you indulged in)." (102:8)
Ayatul kareema. O our Salafi `ulama, what you are saying? You are Arabs and you are knowing too much;
claiming, but you are never saying. Except Arabs, they understand. I am asking to you, what Allah Almighty
saying? Asta`idhu billah, tell me, "waqifoohum - Make them to stop!" Qif! Stop! For what? Innahum
mas'ooloon. Arabs, where are Arabs? But I am saying to those proud `ulama, Salafis or khalafis!
••••••••••• •••••••• ••••••••••••• - Waqifoohum innahum mas'ooloon - but stop them, for they must be asked.
(37:24)
Why you are not saying Hanafi `ulama? Why not saying Hanbali, Shafi`i or Maliki `ulama? What means
salaf? Salaf, you may understand that means: just passed away, from the time of Adam up to today. You are
representing those people? Why you are saying (you are) "Salafi"? Do you think that hawaariyyoon, disciples
of Jesus Christ; you know what Jesus Christ was teaching them?
Today is a new beginning, 1431 and the Lord of Heavens is not happy with us, because all of us are
disobedient servants! You can't find a handful of obedient servants. Therefore, just moved heavenly anger
and approaching. I don't know what is going to happen through this holy month, Muharramu 'l-Haraam.
Allah Almighty was reaching to His prophets (to protect them) when Shayaateen and their followers
disturbing and rushing on them for killing them. And they were asking, "O our Lord! Reach to Your weak
servants. Disobedient servants are rushing on us, asking to take ourselves away and to make this globe only
for Shaytans, not to be for Allah." Their aim, their last target and hope is to make this whole world laa deeni http://www.sufismus-online.de/LordITriedToKnowYourOrders (3 von 5)04.07.2013 23:24:12

no any religion!
But a heavenly anger is ready to come on their heads! I am running away to Allah Almighty because I am not
happy with my ego. If anyone is happy with their ego, they are not happy with Allah, because first fighter
according to the Lord of Heavens, was our ego. Our ego never going to be an obedient one. Therefore, I am
saying when the Lord of Heavens asking, "What you learned about Me? And then, what you learned about My
rights on you, as I am Creator; what were My rights on My servants, you learned it?"
"No, we were secular ones." - "Take them away (from My Presence)!" Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah,
Astaghfirullah. I was hearing in Madinatu 'l-Munawwara when that eclipse happening a secret sound saying,
astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah - O Allah forgive me. O People! Say
astaghfirullah. The Seal of Prophets (s) was saying, "I am saying astaghfirullah daily, 70 times." If he is (s)
saying it 70 times, for ourselves 70 million is not enough!
You can look and see through the faces of a very few people, a clean face, brightened face, enlightened face.
Very, very, very few! (Mawlana mimics as if grooming in mirror) That man, looking very handsome and
ladies at every foot, they are taking and looking. (Laughter) So many ones that they are using so many
cosmetics. Coming from them very bad smelling. Therefore, they are trying to cover that smelling from
themselves by using cosmetics.
Sahaba of the Seal of Prophets (s) they were dressing one shirt that you can't know if it was white or black.
They had no water for washing and if washing one, they must sit naked waiting for it to dry. Therefore, they
are using this for life and my Grandshaykh was saying to me, "O Nazim Effendi, their clothes you can't
differentiate if it is white or black, but if you are smelling, it is smelling of best perfume of roses." Prophet's
(s) command was saying, "taahiru turooqu 'l-Qur’an - purify the pathways of Qur'an." Keep clean. It is the
way of imaan, the way of dhikr, the way of life. Every Sahaba their breathings, just so beautiful smelling,
because they were clean, they were following holy commands of Allah Almighty: taahiru turooqu 'l-Qur’an.
May Allah forgive us. O People! People on wrong way and therefore crisis climbing. Not coming down, but
day-by-day getting more and more and more until they are coming to the way of Paradise. If not, they should
be taken away! That is, all nations now, looking about expected huge events, mentioned in hadith shareef, al-

marhamatu 'l-kubra.
Beware, O People! Hear, listen and obey. The Lord of Heavens asking that knowledge: what you learned
about your Creator and what you learned about your Lords' rights. How you are doing for His rights? Learn
this, no one is learning! Everyone trying to learn about this dunya. Even the Muslim world is trying to be
westernized, mashaa-Allah...
May Allah forgives me, and forgives you. We are hoping in this holy month for heavenly help and support for
weak servants. We are not claiming we are doing any servanthood but we are asking forgiveness. Forgive us,
O our Lord for the honor of Your most honored servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s.) (Mawlana stands)
Fatiha!
